title: Awareness Seminar on CPR
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown organised an informative and highly engaging awareness seminar at K.C. Law College, Churchgate, on CPR, AED usage, heart attacks and cardiac arrest.
description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown organised an informative and highly engaging awareness seminar at K.C. Law College, Churchgate, on CPR, AED usage, heart attacks and cardiac arrest.

The session was conducted by our very own Rotarian, *Dr. Akshay Mehta, Cardiologist*, who explained the importance of recognising cardiac emergencies and taking immediate action.

The highlight of the programme was the live demonstration and hands-on practice of CPR, where students and faculty members actively participated and learned the essential life-saving technique.

The session empowered participants with practical knowledge and confidence to respond during cardiac emergencies, where every second can make a difference.

Because knowing CPR is not just a skill; it is the ability to give someone a second chance at life.
location: t K.C. Law College, Churchgate, Mumbai, Maharashtra
